description: This PHP class 'I18NService' in the namespace 'OrangeHRM\I18N\Service' provides internationalization (i18n) functionalities such as translation management, caching, and language resource handling for the OrangeHRM system. It interacts with data access objects, cache mechanisms, and Symfony translation components to deliver localized messages.

classes.name: I18NService
classes.description: Provides internationalization services including translation retrieval, caching, and resource management using Symfony translation components and project-specific data access objects.

methods.name: getI18NDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the I18NDao instance for accessing translation message data.

methods.name: addLanguage
methods.description: Adds a language-resource pair to the loadedLanguages cache; throws exception if already added.

methods.name: isLanguageLoaded
methods.description: Checks if a specific language-resource pair is already loaded.

methods.name: generateCacheKeyPrefixForLang
methods.description: Generates cache key prefix for a given language code.

methods.name: generateTranslationCacheKey
methods.description: Generates cache key for translation messages.

methods.name: generateTranslationKeyTargetArrayCacheKey
methods.description: Generates cache key for translation key-target array.

methods.name: generateTranslationSourceTargetArrayCacheKey
methods.description: Generates cache key for source-target translation array.

methods.name: generateETagCacheKey
methods.description: Generates cache key for ETag associated with a language.

methods.name: getTranslationCollection
methods.description: Retrieves all translation messages for a language from DAO and organizes into a TranslationCollection.

methods.name: getTranslationMessagesAsJsonStringAlongWithCache
methods.description: Retrieves translation messages as JSON string with caching for a language.

methods.name: getETagAlongWithCache
methods.description: Generates and caches the ETag for a language's translation messages.

methods.name: getTranslationMessagesAsJsonString
methods.description: Gets translation messages as JSON string with cache.

methods.name: getTranslationMessagesKeyTargetArray
methods.description: Returns translation key-target array, utilizing cache.

methods.name: getTranslationMessagesSourceTargetArray
methods.description: Returns source-target translation array, utilizing cache.

methods.name: cleanAndRefetchIfCacheNotHit
methods.description: Refetches cache if a cache miss occurs, and clears related cache entries.

methods.name: getETagByLangCode
methods.description: Retrieves or generates ETag for a given language code.

methods.name: getTranslator
methods.description: Initializes and returns the Symfony Translator instance configured with default locale and loader.

methods.name: setTranslatorLanguage
methods.description: Sets the locale for the Translator instance.

methods.name: trans
methods.description: Translates a given key with parameters for a specific language context.

methods.name: transBySource
methods.description: Translates a source string to the target language context.

methods.name: cleanCacheByLangCode
methods.description: Clears cached translation data for a specific language code.
